notes:
v0.6.44: bootstrap hardened to recover from partial runs.

Operator reported 2026-09-09 19:50 MDT: on a freshly-flashed
ReticulumHF box where the bootstrap had been run earlier, :80
was the ReticulumHF wizard, not the launcher; the launcher
wasn't running at all.

Diagnosis: the bootstrap had completed phases 0-6 (apt
install, pipx venvs, modem73 .deb, repo clone) and got part
of the way through phase 7 (overlay config + systemd units)
but died before the for-loop that copies systemd units. So
the box had:
- node-portal installed (created via `tee`, not the for-loop)
- drop-in for the wizard created
- BUT: g90-shared-launcher.service, meshchatx.service, lxmd,
  pat-http, novnc-session, zerotier-one NOT installed
- BUT: modem73 default settings NOT installed
- BUT: Reticulum config [[Modem73]] block NOT appended
- AND: the wizard (running with pre-drop-in env) was still
  bound to :80, so the launcher's bind on :80 would have
  failed even if the unit had been installed

Three fixes:
1. The systemd unit for-loop now wraps each `cp` in `|| true`
   so a single failure doesn't abort the whole phase.
2. After the wizard's drop-in is created, the script now
   `systemctl restart reticulumhf-portal` to force the wizard
   to re-read its environment and bind :8080 instead of :80.
3. Phase 9 now kills any stale root python3 holding :80
   (from a manual `sudo python3 ...` invocation) and any
   stale wizard on :80 (running with the pre-drop-in env),
   so a re-run of the bootstrap recovers the box from the
   broken state instead of just being a no-op.

Effect: the bootstrap is now safe to re-run after a partial
or interrupted execution. Operators (or any future automated
agent) can simply `bash /tmp/reticulumpi-bootstrap.sh` again
to repair a half-installed box.

The reticulumpi box at 192.168.1.145 was hand-recovered
during this session by running the same steps the bootstrap
would have run: copy units, install modem73 settings, append
[[Modem73]] block, restart wizard, kill stale processes.
All 12 components now match v0.6.43.
